 News › News News › School Holiday Today: Schools to remain closed on october 20 for Dussehra; check this week and novem… School Holiday Today: Schools to remain closed on october 20 for Dussehra; check this week and november 2026 holiday list
 Sajid Raza Updated: Oct 20, 2026, 11:56 IST School Holiday Dussehra or Vijayadashami is a festival that is celebrated in several parts of India and it is expected that schools will be closed on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. The school holiday schedule for the upcoming festive seasons and reopening dates are being confirmed by students and parents as several states are currently observing Dussehra vacation.
 School holiday schedules differ from state to state, district to district and institution to institution. Some schools will have a holiday on Dussehra and some have adopted the extended autumn break or Durga Puja vacation. Students may also see the big school vacations in Nov 2026 like Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti.
 School Holiday Today: Is october 20 a holiday for Dussehra? 
 Yes, in most parts of India the first day of Dussehra celebration is Tuesday, October 20. 
 It is a festival celebrating the triumph of good over evil and is celebrated with festivities, religious ceremonies and cultural events.
 Various schools in India will be celebrating holidays on the occasion of Durga Ashtami and Dussehra, which falls on October 19 and 20th respectively. The school closing dates will be based on the state holiday calendar for the applicable state and the school's own academic calendar, however.
 The school holiday updates are as follows: Delhi NCR Schools have a festive break from October 18 to 20 and Uttar Pradesh schools are said to have an autumn break from October 18 to 25. The same applies to schools in Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh which are scheduled for their own festive breaks.
 Students will need to verify their school's official notice for whether they should return to school for classes on October 21 or after the extended break.
 School Holiday This Week: October 19 to 25, 2026 
 The third week of October includes Dussehra and extended festive breaks in several states. Here is a look at the reported school holiday schedules.
 Date Day Holiday or occasion 
 October 19 Monday Durga Ashtami/Maha Ashtami; holiday in several states 
 October 20 Tuesday Dussehra/Vijayadashami 
 October 21 Wednesday Additional festive holiday in some states, including West Bengal and Jharkhand 
 October 22 Thursday Schools may reopen in some states after the Dasara break 
 October 23 Friday Regular classes may resume, depending on the school calendar 
 October 24 Saturday Weekly off in schools that observe a Saturday holiday 
 October 25 Sunday Weekly holiday 
 November 2026 School Holidays : Complete list of important dates 
 November 2026 will bring several festival-related holidays for school students. Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, while Guru Nanak Jayanti will be observed on Tuesday, November 24.
 The following dates are important for students and parents planning their school schedules.
 Date Day Festival or occasion 
 November 8 Sunday Diwali/Deepavali 
 November 9 Monday Govardhan Puja 
 November 11 Wednesday Bhai Dooj 
 November 14 Saturday Children's Day 
 November 15 Sunday Chhath Puja 
 November 24 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti/Gurpurab 
 Note: These are important festival dates, not a guarantee that every school will remain closed on each date. Some holidays may be restricted or region-specific and Children's Day is not a nationwide school holiday.
 Diwali School Holiday 2026 
 Diwali, also known as Deepavali, will fall on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Schools in several states may provide an extended Diwali break around the festival, depending on their academic calendars.
 Some schools may remain closed on additional days for Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj. 
 Students should check the official school holiday list to confirm the duration of the Diwali vacation.
 Govardhan Puja Holiday on November 9 
 Govardhan Puja will be observed on Monday, November 9, 2026. The occasion is celebrated in several parts of India, particularly in northern states.
 Schools in regions where Govardhan Puja is a notified holiday may remain closed. The decision will depend on the state government's holiday list and the school's calendar.
 Bhai Dooj Holiday on November 11 
 Bhai Dooj will fall on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The festival celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters and is observed in many parts of India.
 Some schools may include Bhai Dooj in their Diwali vacation, while others may follow their regular timetable if the date is not a designated holiday.
 Chhath Puja Holiday on November 15 
 Chhath Puja will be observed on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The festival is celebrated particularly in Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh and parts of other states.
 Since the festival falls on a Sunday, it will coincide with the weekly holiday for many schools. Additional closures, if any, will depend on state and district announcements.
 Guru Nanak Jayanti Holiday on November 24 
 Guru Nanak Jayanti, also known as Gurpurab, will be observed on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. The occasion marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism.
 Schools in several states may remain closed on the occasion, subject to the applicable holiday calendar.
 Will schools have an extended holiday in November 2026?
 Students may get an extended break around Diwali if their schools combine the festival with Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj holidays. However, the length of the break will differ across states and institutions.
 In some schools, the Diwali break may begin before November 8 and continue until November 11. Other schools may observe only the notified festival holidays and weekly offs.
 There is no single nationwide school holiday schedule for November 2026. Parents should check the official circular issued by their school or the relevant state education department before making travel plans.
